question: Where can I find a university within 70 kilometers toward the southwest of 70 Park Avenue Hotel, New York, NY?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%70 Park Avenue Hotel%' LIMIT 1 ) AS hotel WHERE p.amenity = 'university' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, hotel.geometry::geography, 70000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(hotel.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5;
